scope: The Great Lavra Bell Tower in Kyiv around the July 2013 Qualla photographs, including the yellow masonry base, three white-columned upper stages, open belfries, gilded dome, lantern and cross. Other monastery buildings and surrounding walls are separate structures.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The national preserve records the four-tier tower, 96.52m height, 29m base diameter and 8m lower wall thickness.
The preserve describes eagle capitals on the fourth tier and a chime clock without a dial or hands.
Kyiv’s official city guide confirms the 1731–1745 construction period, designer Johann Gottfried Schädel, and 96.52m height.
